name: Admin Diagnostic JSON Export
description: Admin opens the JSON tab of /panel/diagnostics/:id/edit. A read-only textarea renders the full diagnostic serialized as JSON (metadata + sections). Actualizar refetches /detail/ from the server; Copiar writes the current text to the clipboard; Descargar streams a {slug}.json Blob download. The string is lazy-computed from store.current so it rebuilds only when the tab is rendered.
